Overview

Applied AI & GenAI for Retail & Consumer Goods earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from commerce & POS estates and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. The Retail & Consumer Goods operating reality gives this work its shape: fresh waste pressure at event speed, GDPR / privacy regimes obligations on every artifact, and practitioners who will not accept recommendations they cannot interrogate. The pattern below is calibrated to those three forces.
